headline: Tender day reshuffled the market: Royce Lewis is a Dodger, Bailey Ober and Nolan Gorman are free agents, and Skubal has a mystery fifth suitor.

news.title: Twins trade Royce Lewis to Dodgers, non-tender Ober and Larnach
news.note: The 2017 No. 1 pick goes to L.A. for Bobby Miller and catching prospect Francisco Espinoza. Minnesota also cut Bailey Ober and Trevor Larnach.

news.title: Complete list of non-tendered players
news.note: Nolan Gorman (Cardinals), Luis Gil (Yankees), David Fry (Guardians), Luke Raley (Mariners) and Matt Vierling (Tigers) are among the new free agents. Jarren Duran was tendered.

news.title: Yankees bring back Jonathan Loáisiga
news.note: Two years with a 2029 club option, per ESPN. He had a 2.42 ERA and 172 ERA+ for Arizona in 2026.

news.title: Mystery team meets Skubal; Peralta has six-plus suitors
news.note: A fifth, undisclosed team met Skubal over Zoom (Heyman). Bowden counts more than six teams on Peralta, and Morosi says the White Sox are in on King and Peralta.

news.title: Cubs claim Joey Bart, add Braxton Roxby
news.note: Chicago's North Side club took the former No. 2 pick off waivers from the White Sox and got Roxby from Washington for cash.
